title: Kyrenia Coast & Medieval Castles Route
description: Drive through the breathtaking Beşparmak (Pentadaktylos) Mountains. Scale the high battlements of St. Hilarion Castle, stroll the quiet ruins of Bellapais Abbey, and wind down along Girne's sparkling coastal beaches and dining venues.

stops.name: Mavi Köşk (The Blue House)
stops.description: A mysterious mid-century villa filled with secret passages, Greek-Italian art, and unique architectures, built by a mysterious gunrunner.
stops.history: Built in 1957 by Byron Pavlides, the attorney and defense agent of Cyprus. Features hidden safes, a concrete pool, and a double-view bedroom.

stops.name: St. Hilarion Castle
stops.description: One of the best-preserved crusader fortresses in Cyprus. Situated high in the Kyrenia range, it offers spectacular panoramic views of the coast.
stops.history: Originally a monastery built in the 10th century, it was fortified by the Byzantines and Lusignans. It is said to have inspired Walt Disney's Snow White castle.

stops.name: Kyrenia Tandem Paragliding
stops.description: Soar above Kyrenia with tandem paragliding! Glide 800m high over the Mediterranean and Kyrenia Mountains, enjoying breathtaking views, adrenaline, serenity, and unforgettable memories.
stops.history: Paragliding in the Kyrenia range offers one of the most stunning flight paths in the world, starting from the heights of the Beşparmak Mountains and landing near the harbor.

stops.name: Ulfet Beach Club
stops.description: A refined beach club along the Kyrenia coastline offering sunbeds, a bar, and clear waters, ideal to relax after climbing mountain castles.
stops.history: A popular summer club that highlights Girne's seaside leisure scene with modern facilities, cocktails, and gorgeous sunsets.

stops.name: Vola Coffee
stops.description: A stylish, artisanal specialty coffee spot in Kyrenia, perfect for a caffeine break and fresh, modern baked treats.
stops.history: A contemporary addition to the city's cafe culture, offering premium espresso blends and a cozy design loved by locals and travelers alike.

stops.name: Bellapais Abbey
stops.description: The ruins of a beautiful 13th-century monastery, showcasing masterpiece gothic arches and peaceful gardens overlooking the blue sea.
stops.history: Built by the Canons Regular of the Holy Sepulchre. British writer Lawrence Durrell lived nearby and immortalized the village in his book 'Bitter Lemons'.

stops.name: Kybele Restaurant
stops.description: Set directly within the grounds of Bellapais Abbey, this high-end restaurant offers modern Mediterranean cuisine and fine dining with dramatic views.
stops.history: Renowned for hosting prestigious dinners and tourists visiting the Abbey, it blends architectural history with upscale local gastronomy.

travelTips: The road climbing to St. Hilarion Castle has steep inclines; make sure your vehicle's cooling system is in good order.
Visit St. Hilarion early in the morning to avoid the midday sun and tourist buses.
Remember that Mavi Köşk is inside a military zone; you will need to present your passport/ID at the military gate to enter.
